"import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook

# Create a new workbook (copy of input would be loaded if available)
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Sheet1"

# Corrected VBA macro code
vba_code = [
    "Sub DeleteRowsBeforeChassis()",
    "    Dim ws As Worksheet",
    "    Dim lastRow As Long",
    "    Dim i As Long",
    "    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(\"Import Data\")",
    "    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, \"A\").End(xlUp).Row",
    "    i = lastRow",
    "    Do While i >= 5",
    "        If ws.Cells(i, 1).Value = \"Chassis\" Then",
    "            ws.Range(ws.Cells(i - 4, 1), ws.Cells(i - 1, 1)).EntireRow.Delete",
    "            i = i - 4",
    "        End If",
    "        i = i - 1",
    "    Loop",
    "End Sub"
]

# Write VBA code to cells A1:A15
for idx, line in enumerate(vba_code, start=1):
    ws.cell(row=idx, column=1, value=line)

# Save the workbook
wb.save("output.xlsx")"
